name: Apple visionOS 2 Security Technical Implementation Guide
description: This Security Technical Implementation Guide is published as a tool to improve the security of Department of Defense (DOD) information systems. The requirements are derived from the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 and related documents. Comments or proposed revisions to this document should be sent via email to the following address: disa.stig_spt@mail.mil.

rules.title: Apple visionOS 2 must allow the administrator (MDM) to perform the following management function: enable/disable VPN protection across the device and [selection: on a per-app basis, on a per-group of applications processes basis].
Apple visionOS 2 must not allow backup to remote systems (iCloud).
Apple visionOS 2 must not allow backup to remote systems (iCloud document and data synchronization).
Apple visionOS 2 must not allow backup to remote systems (iCloud Keychain).
Apple visionOS 2 must not allow backup to remote systems (Cloud Photo Library).
Apple visionOS 2 must not allow backup to remote systems (managed applications data stored in iCloud).
Apple visionOS 2 must be configured to enforce a minimum password length of six characters.
Apple visionOS 2 must be configured to not allow passwords that include more than four repeating or sequential characters.
Apple visionOS 2 must be configured to lock the display after 15 minutes (or fewer) of inactivity.
Apple visionOS 2 must be configured to not allow more than 10 consecutive failed authentication attempts.
Apple visionOS 2 must be configured to enforce a passcode reuse prohibition of at least two generations.

Apple visionOS 2 must be configured to enforce an application installation policy by specifying one or more authorized application repositories, including [selection: DOD-approved commercial app repository, MDM server, mobile application store].
Apple visionOS 2 must be configured to not display notifications when the device is locked.
Apple visionOS 2 must be configured to display the DOD advisory warning message at startup or each time the user unlocks the device.
Apple visionOS 2 must not allow non-DOD applications to access DOD data.
Apple visionOS 2 must be configured to [selection: wipe protected data, wipe sensitive data] upon unenrollment from MDM.
Apple visionOS 2 must be configured to [selection: remove Enterprise applications, remove all noncore applications (any nonfactory-installed application)] upon unenrollment from MDM.
Apple visionOS 2 must be configured to disable ad hoc wireless client-to-client connection capability.
Apple visionOS 2 must require a valid password be successfully entered before the mobile device data is unencrypted.
Apple visionOS 2 must implement the management setting: not allow automatic completion of Safari browser passcodes.
Apple visionOS 2 must implement the management setting: not allow use of Handoff.
Apple visionOS 2 must implement the management setting: disable Allow MailDrop.
Vision Pro must have the latest available visionOS operating system installed.
Apple visionOS 2 must implement the management setting: use Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) for Exchange ActiveSync.
Apple visionOS 2 must implement the management setting: not allow messages in an ActiveSync Exchange account to be forwarded or moved to other accounts in the Apple visionOS 2 Mail app.
Apple visionOS 2 must implement the management setting: treat AirDrop as an unmanaged destination.
Apple visionOS 2 users must complete required training.
A managed photo app must be used to take and store work-related photos.
Apple visionOS 2 must not allow managed apps to write contacts to unmanaged contacts accounts.
Apple visionOS 2 must not allow unmanaged apps to read contacts from managed contacts accounts.
Apple visionOS 2 must implement the management setting: disable AirDrop.
Apple visionOS 2 must disable "Password AutoFill" in browsers and applications.
Apple visionOS 2 must disable password sharing.
The Apple visionOS 2 must be supervised by the MDM.
The Apple visionOS must be configured to disable automatic transfer of diagnostic data to an external device other than an MDM service with which the device has enrolled.
Apple visionOS must implement the management setting: not allow a user to remove Apple visionOS configuration profiles that enforce DOD security requirements.
Apple visionOS 2 must disable "Allow network drive access in Files access".
Apple visionOS 2 must disable connections to Siri servers for the purpose of dictation.
Apple visionOS 2 must disable copy/paste of data from managed to unmanaged applications.
Apple visionOS 2 must have DOD root and intermediate PKI certificates installed.
Apple visionOS 2 must disable ChatGPT connection for Apple Intelligence.
Apple visionOS 2 must disable the download of visionOS beta updates.
Apple Vision Pro hardware must not be modified to use the Developer Strap unless use is approved on a case-by-case basis by the authorizing official (AO).
Apple visionOS 2 must disable the ability of the user to wipe the device.
Apple visionOS 2 must disable the use voice assistant (Siri) unless required to meet Section 508 compliance requirements.
Apple visionOS 2 must disable Apple Intelligence feature: Image Generation.
Apple visionOS 2 must disable Apple Intelligence feature: generate new Genmoji.
DOD Apple visionOS 2 devices must have a Mobile Threat Detection (MTD) app installed.
DOD Apple visionOS 2 devices must disable screenshots and screen recordings.
Apple visionOS 2 must implement the management setting: disable the Bluetooth radio.
